set.body:
Inherited Studio progress JSON precision defect, found during independent UI-D S1 review at 8b58a6a6f3f975af0ecb744ddec7e7d59c1d92e3/tree880432f6305b1b003c21dbf1827dc93a64db64b1. Protocol.scala:212-218 emits Long done as a JSON number and decodes it with Circe. Public StageMeter.of accepts all nonnegative Long values. On Scala.js, decode[StageMeter](meter.asJson.noSpaces) changes 9007199254740993 to 9007199254740992 and refuses Long.MaxValue with DecodingFailure at .done: Long; JVM preserves both. In-memory Json.as succeeds, so existing in-memory roundtrip checks do not cover the text transport.

Reproduced with both legacy ProgressTotal.Unknown and new Counting. Counted validation and StageMeter type/constructor/encoder/decoder are byte-identical to base combined3c82d83, confirmed in wire-source-classification.json. This is inherited, not an S1-introduced codec regression; no separate base binary run claimed.

Evidence: /private/tmp/eyes4s-ui-d-review-8b58a6a/IndependentWireRangeClassificationSuite.scala; wire-range-classification.log and .meta.json (JVM10/10 pass, JS6/10 pass, 4 failures; exit1), original independent-runtime.log (JVM Counting max passes, JS fails). Tests and red receipts retained in detached .claude/worktrees/review-ui-d-s1-8b58a6a, production sources untouched.

Acceptance: choose and document a compatible progress wire policy for counts beyond JavaScript safe integers; either preserve accepted Long values across actual JSON text transport or refuse unsupported values with typed operands. Test JVM and JS text decoding at 2^53-1, 2^53, 2^53+1 and Long.MaxValue, with negative refusal. Audit related progress/count fields for the same issue. Preserve existing wire pins or explicitly version any necessary break. No repair, owner assignment, or S1 landing block is implied by this filing.
set.title: Studio progress JSON text loses large Long counts on Scala.js
